title: Hearing Range, Ultrasound and SONAR
summary: Infrasound, audible sound and ultrasound; how bats and ships use echoes; medical scans and other uses of ultrasound.
objectives: I can state the range of human hearing.
I can describe uses of ultrasound.
I can calculate depths and distances using SONAR.
misconceptions: Ultrasound is just very loud sound.
Animals hear the same range as humans.
